name: OfferEvo
description: Customers create offers for local businesses. Businesses approve them before they go live, and people discover, share and use them in store with a QR or eight-character code.

capabilities.name: Browse offers
capabilities.description: Browse public deals and profiles without signing in.

capabilities.name: Suggest an offer
capabilities.description: Sign in with Google and submit an offer for a listed venue. Owner approval is required.

capabilities.name: Approve offers
capabilities.description: Owners review customer submissions and decide what becomes public.

capabilities.name: Share an offer
capabilities.description: Share public links or Square, Story and Wide images. Options depend on the device and browser.

capabilities.name: Redeem in store
capabilities.description: Show a QR or eight-character code for staff validation at the named venue. One redemption per person per offer.

capabilities.name: Manage a business
capabilities.description: Use the same account for venue profiles, approvals, customer records and analytics.

limitations: Expired or sold-out offers cannot be redeemed.
Availability depends on participating venues near the customer.
